title: Appleton and Monsoon Pasta
description: A simple Italian pasta dish made with Appleton and Monsoon. A perfect balance of flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add Appleton and Monsoon. Stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the mixture is fragrant.
Add cooked spaghetti to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve with grated parmesan cheese if desired.
